name: Rebecca Stannage
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Alongsidie Bec Counselling offers a warm, supportive, and compassionate space where you can feel heard, understood, and empowered to navigate life's challenges. Whether you're experiencing anxiety, stress, burnout, relationship challenges, ADHD, autism, trauma, women's wellbeing concerns, life transitions, or simply feeling stuck, I provide a safe, non-judgemental space where we can work together towards greater wellbeing and resilience. My approach is person-centred, trauma-informed, and strengths-based, recognising that every person's story is unique.

name: Rebekah Jones
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

name: Rita Hojnik
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Whether in person or online, I'm dedicated to creating meaningful connections. My passion lies in providing a listening ear, offering encouragement, and creating a safe debriefing space for you. Guiding you through the journey of unfolding, rediscovering innate wisdom, and reconnecting with your uniquely beautiful self is what drives me.

name: Sally Tanner
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: From the outside, it may look like you're holding it all together - "coping fine." While on the inside it feels things are starting to unravel. You may be feeling disconnected, anxious, overwhelmed, frustrated, exhausted, or simply unsure how to move forward. My approach is collaborative, trauma-informed and genuinely non-judgemental.

name: Samantha Lehmann
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Hi, I’m Samantha Payne, M.A.C.A. (Level 1), Registered Counsellor and founder of The Connection Room. I believe that meaningful change begins when people feel genuinely heard, understood and accepted.

name: Sandeep Adnani
title: Counsellor (ACA International)
description: I am a professional counsellor providing online counselling in Australia, specializing in grief and loss , child parenting, relationship & conflict management and issues related to anxiety, stress, self-esteem, life transitions and decision-making, and an International member of the Australian Counselling Association (ACA). I am a multi-lingual individual, having lived in four different countries and experienced various different cultures, my life experience and qualifications have given me a sound understanding of human interactions and patterns. I easily identify and address issues and concerns, putting people at ease with my calm, attentive approach.

name: Sandra Best
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: At Juniper Tree Counselling, I specialise in couples counselling and provide dedicated support for parents and caregivers of individuals with ASD, ADHD and other neurodevelopmental disorders. I also offer guidance and support for those living with or caring for loved ones facing mental health challenges. I am here to help you navigate relationship dynamics and personal growth.
